title: andropogon campbellii
intro: Andropogon campbellii, commonly known as Vetiver grass or Khas grass, is a type of perennial plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to India and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and as a natural remedy for various health issues. The health benefits of Andropogon campbellii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
